disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing in violation of this chapter or the board's rules
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The holder of the certificate of registration or license is practicing in violation of this chapter or of the proper rules of the board governing this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining the license or certificate of registration by fraud or misrepresentation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The license or certificate of registration has been obtained by fraud or misrepresentation or the person named therein has obtained it by fraud or misrepresentation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Money other than regular fees paid for the license or certificate of registration
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Money other than the regular fees provided for has been paid for the license or certificate of registration

disciplinary_grounds.description: Falsely impersonating a practitioner or practicing under an assumed or fictitious name
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The holder of the license or certificate of registration is falsely impersonating a practitioner or former practitioner of a like or different name or is practicing under an assumed or fictitious name

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony listed under § 17-3-102
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The holder of the license or certificate of registration has been guilty of a felony listed under § 17-3-102

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding or abetting in the practice of architecture by a person not duly authorized
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The holder of the license or certificate of registration has aided or abetted in the practice of architecture a person not duly authorized to practice architecture under this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud, deceit, gross negligence, or misconduct in the practice of architecture
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The holder of the license or certificate of registration has been guilty of fraud or deceit or of gross negligence or misconduct in the practice of architecture

disciplinary_grounds.description: Gross incompetency or recklessness in the construction or designing of buildings
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The holder of the certificate of registration or license has been guilty of gross incompetency or recklessness in the construction or designing of buildings

disciplinary_grounds.description: Affixing or permitting affixing of seal/name to documents not prepared under responsible supervisory control
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The holder of the license or certificate of registration affixed or permitted to be affixed his or her seal or name to any plans, specifications, drawings, or related documents that were not prepared by him or her or under his or her responsible supervisory control

disciplinary_grounds.description: Adjudged mentally incapable by a court of competent jurisdiction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The holder of the license or certificate of registration has been adjudged mentally incapable by a court of competent jurisdiction.

definition_quote.value: "Practice of architecture" means the provision of, or offering to provide, services in connection with the design and construction, enlargement, or alteration of a building or group of buildings, and the space within and surrounding such buildings, which is designed for human occupancy or habitation.

permitted_firm_structures.quote: A partnership or a corporation may be admitted to practice architecture in this state if: Two-thirds (2/3) of the partners, if a partnership, or two-thirds (2/3) of the directors, if a corporation, are registered under the laws of any state to practice architecture or engineering

seal_required.quote: Upon registration, each registrant hereunder shall obtain a seal of such design as the Arkansas State Board of Architects, Landscape Architects, and Interior Designers shall authorize and direct. Plans and specifications prepared by, or under the direct supervision of, a registered architect shall be stamped with this seal during the life of the registrant's certificate.

seal_surrender_required_on_license_termi.quote: It shall be unlawful for anyone to stamp or seal any documents with the seal after the certificate of the registrant named thereon has expired or has been revoked unless the certificate shall have been renewed or reissued.

exempt_building_types.quote: The following shall be exempt from the provisions of this chapter: A professional engineer, as defined in § 17-30-101, but only for work incidental to engineering practice if the professional engineer does not use the designation "architect" or any related term; Employees of those lawfully practicing architecture who are acting under the instruction, control, or supervision of their employer; Officers and employees of the United States Government while engaged within this state in the practice of architecture for the government; Residents of this state who do not use the title "architect" or any term derived therefrom who act as designers for: Buildings that are to be constructed for personal use, such as residences, if the buildings are not intended or adaptable for public employment, assembly, or any other use under which they will be open to the public; Single family detached, duplex, triplex, and quadruplex dwellings; or Buildings whose total cumulative and fair market value to complete, not including site, does not exceed two hundred fifty thousand dollars ($250,000)
